attributes.residual: TWO INSTRUMENT DEFECTS FOUND AND FIXED THAT WERE NOT ON THE QUEUE, both surfaced by writing the tests. (a) defake_gate's arbitration log keyed on the raw unit string, so `arbitrations game/sys/memcard` reported zero events for a unit that had just logged one; events are now keyed extensionless via bare_unit(). A scoping filter that silently answers 'none' is the same failure class as an unscreened negative. (b) fndiff's module docstring claimed --count excludes 'reloc-name-only noise' when it excludes EVERY reloc line, which is half of why the two-reals confusion persisted; corrected.
